components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action for the main available operation.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(162, 173, 255, 0.24); border-radius: 8px; background: #dce0ff; color: #10111a; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: rgba(226, 229, 255, 0.8); background: #edf0ff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9eabff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action that stays low emphasis until hovered.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(126, 146, 175, 0.17); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a0a3ae; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.065); color: #f0f1f5; } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9eabff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Coral treatment for stop, remove, and other destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 116, 128, 0.22); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 116, 128, 0.09); color: #f08a94; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background: rgba(255, 116, 128, 0.16); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9eabff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Compact text field used for project, settings, and terminal input.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(16, 17, 22, 0.88); color: #f0f1f5; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #858995; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.17); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9eabff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(162, 173, 255, 0.16); border-radius: 7px; background: rgba(162, 173, 255, 0.1); color: #c5cbff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #f0f1f5; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9eabff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip span { color: #a2adff; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Navigation Dock
components.description: Floating switcher between Projects and Dashboard.
components.css: .ds-dock { position: fixed; z-index: 90; bottom: 18px; left: 50%; display: flex; width: max-content; max-width: calc(100vw - 24px); gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(17, 18, 23, 0.84); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%); transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-dock-button { min-width: 126px; min-height: 38px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a0a3ae; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 560; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dock-button:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); color: #f0f1f5; } .ds-dock-button.ds-is-current { background: rgba(162, 173, 255, 0.14); color: #c7ceff; } .ds-dock-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9eabff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dock-button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-dock { top: max(2px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); right: 12px; bottom: auto; left: auto; transform: none; } .ds-dock-button { width: 36px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding: 0; } .ds-dock-button span { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } }

components.name: Project Split Pane
components.description: Asymmetric project list with selected-project details at the right.
components.html:
ProjectServices and status
Services

Project details and service controls
components.css: .ds-project-workspace { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(250px, 42fr) minmax(0, 58fr); gap: 12px; min-height: 440px; } .ds-project-row { grid-column: 1; min-height: 78px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(15, 16, 21, 0.78); color: #f0f1f5; font: 600 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-project-row small { color: #858995; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-project-row.ds-is-selected { border-color: rgba(162, 173, 255, 0.36); background: rgba(39, 41, 58, 0.5); } .ds-project-detail { position: absolute; z-index: 8; inset: 0 0 auto calc(42% + 6px); height: min(74vh, 760px); min-height: min(440px, 68vh); overflow: auto; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(15, 16, 21, 0.9); color: #f0f1f5; } .ds-project-detail p { color: #a0a3ae; font-size: 12px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-project-workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 0; } .ds-project-row { grid-column: 1; } .ds-project-detail { position: static; height: auto; min-height: 0; margin-top: 8px; } }

components.name: Dashboard Metric
components.description: One of three selected-service KPI cards.
components.html:
CPU
—Aguardando leitura de métricas
components.css: .ds-kpi { --kpi-color: #aab4ff; min-height: 138px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(15, 16, 21, 0.82); color: #f2f2f5; } .ds-kpi-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: #a0a3ae; font: 600 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--kpi-color) 25%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--kpi-color) 10%, transparent); color: var(--kpi-color); } .ds-kpi-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-kpi strong { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; font: 580 25px/1.1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi-sparkline { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 96px; height: 30px; overflow: visible; } .ds-kpi-sparkline polyline { fill: none; stroke: var(--kpi-color); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-kpi small { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: #858995; font: 10px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-log-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); border-radius: 10px; background: #0b0c10; } .ds-log-header { min-height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); color: #d0d1d8; font: 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-log-output { max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 12px 14px 14px; background: #090a0d; color: #d0d1d8; font: 11px/1.7 'JetBrains Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; scrollbar-color: #3a3b45 #090a0d; scrollbar-width: thin; } .ds-log-output p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Terminal Output
components.description: Dark monospace shell transcript and command-entry context.
components.html: Digite um comando para começar.
components.css: .ds-terminal-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 10px; background: #0b0c10; } .ds-terminal-output { min-height: 120px; max-height: 320px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); border-radius: 8px; background: #090a0d; color: #d0d1d8; font: 11px/1.7 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-terminal-prompt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #63d7a3; font: 12px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-terminal-prompt input { min-width: 0; min-height: 34px; flex: 1; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(16, 17, 22, 0.88); color: #f0f1f5; font: 12px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-terminal-prompt input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9eabff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-terminal-prompt button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(162, 173, 255, 0.24); border-radius: 8px; background: #dce0ff; color: #10111a; font: 600 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
Deep Obsidian is a local operations workbench for Docker Compose projects: an almost-black canvas, subtle indigo and cool-teal radial light, fine low-contrast borders, and restrained color for selection and service state. The interface prioritizes scanning and context retention over decoration. Projects sit beside their open service/detail pane, while a compact floating dock switches between Projects and Dashboard. Dark is the initial theme; a light theme is also implemented.

The typography and controls stay compact so project and service status remain easy to scan. On desktop, projects use an asymmetric list-and-detail arrangement; on narrow screens, the detail pane flows below its project and the dock moves to the upper-right reserved header area. This document describes the shipped visual language, not additional product capabilities.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black surfaces with restrained radial light and fine dividers.
Lavender selection, with green, cyan, amber, and coral reserved for semantic status or metric cues.
Compact controls and an asymmetric project-to-detail workspace.

rules.name: The Accent-as-State Rule
rules.body: Keep lavender concentrated on selected, focused, or primary-action states; use green, cyan, amber, and coral for their existing semantic roles rather than as decoration.

rules.name: The Readable-State Rule
rules.body: Keep labels and state text distinct from subdued metadata; do not make operational status depend on color alone.

rules.name: The Flat-Card Rule
rules.body: Keep project, service, and metric cards flat at rest; use borders and tonal layering, not card shadows, to establish their edges.

dos: Do keep lavender concentrated on selection, focus, and primary-action states.
Do use fine borders and tonal surfaces before adding shadows to cards.
Do preserve the asymmetric project/detail relationship on desktop and its in-flow mobile form.
Do keep KPI colors paired with their established CPU, memory, and port roles.
Do retain a dark console surface for logs and terminal output in both themes.
donts: Don't replace the pinned Deep Obsidian world with a bright, high-chroma interface.
Don't add shadows to ordinary project, service, or metric cards.
Don't turn the filter chips into capsules; their active treatment is softly squared.
Don't present unavailable metric readings as real values or imply that port checks cover UDP.
